findings.title: Yup validation error not surfaced in categories field
findings.problem: Both Controller usages for categories (WorkflowFormFields.tsx:298 and GeneralConfigTab.tsx:226) destructure only { field }, discarding fieldState. MarketplaceCategories accepts no external error prop. The component enforces max-3 via its internal handleChange UI guard, but if categories are set programmatically via setValue with more than 3 values, Yup fires the .max(3) error and blocks submission with no visible feedback near the field.
findings.impact: A user (or AI-assist fill) that triggers the Yup path rather than the UI guard sees the form silently refuse to submit with no indication of which field has an error or why.
findings.recommendation: Add error?: string to MarketplaceCategoriesProps, render it below the MultiSelect (same pattern as the Input component's error prop already used on icon_url). In both Controller render functions, destructure { field, fieldState } and pass fieldState.error?.message as the error prop.

findings.title: null API value causes Yup type error in categories
findings.problem: The categories field is declared as Yup.array().of(...).max(3).optional().default([]). Yup's .optional() only allows undefined; it does not coerce null. If the API returns null for categories (regression or older server), Yup throws a type validation error at parse time instead of coercing to an empty array.
findings.impact: An opaque Yup type error blocks form submission or form initialisation when the API payload carries null for categories, with no user-visible indication of the cause.

findings.title: All 4 commit subjects violate required uppercase format, blocking CI
findings.problem: Commits a91402c ('un-gate categories filter for my/all workflow scopes'), 5e94ceb ('add categories field to visual editor GeneralConfigTab'), 3e1418f ('add categories field to workflow text-editor form path'), and 035ec7f ('add categories to Workflow type and baseWorkflowSchema') all begin with a lowercase word after the colon, violating the documented ^EPMCDME-\d+:\s[A-Z][a-z]* regex.
findings.impact: Tekton CI enforces the commit-message regex and blocks the pipeline on non-conforming commits, preventing the branch from merging.
findings.recommendation: Reword all four commit subjects so the first word is capitalised: e.g. 'Un-gate categories filter for my/all workflow scopes', 'Add categories field to visual editor GeneralConfigTab', 'Add categories field to workflow text-editor form path', 'Add categories to Workflow type and baseWorkflowSchema'. Use git rebase -i to reword in place.
